title: Reefer Cargo Services: Cancellation of a Reefer Service
content:
A Reefer Cargo Services order can be withdrawn up to the moment the laden reefer goes onto power at the load terminal. This page sets out who can bring about a cancellation, until when, and what it costs at each stage.

## Clause

A reefer service is cancelled either on the customer's instruction or together with the booking it belongs to, and in either case only while the reefer has not yet been plugged in. If the service is cancelled while still requested, before the inspection, no charge arises. If it is cancelled after the inspection, the inspection charge remains in place, and the tier's fee for cancelling after inspection is added to the service once, under the cancellation fee heading, whenever that fee is above 0.00. Once the reefer is plugged in, the service cannot be cancelled on its own: the way out lies in cancelling the booking under the booking terms, with the laden container withdrawn from the terminal.

## Cost by status at the time of cancellation

| Service status | Can the service be cancelled? | Charges that result |
|---|---|---|
| requested | yes | none |
| inspection passed | yes | inspection charge stays; cancellation fee added once if the tier's fee is above 0.00 |
| plugged in | no | not applicable |
| in transit, delivered or closed | no, the reefer having already been plugged in | not applicable |

## Hypothetical illustrations

- A shipper withdraws an order that is still requested: the service becomes cancelled and nothing is charged.
- A shipper withdraws an order at inspection passed on an imagined tier whose post-inspection cancellation fee is 120.00: the inspection charge already booked remains, and 120.00 is added once as a cancellation fee.
- The same withdrawal on an imagined tier whose post-inspection cancellation fee is 0.00: the inspection charge remains and no cancellation fee is entered.
- The booking itself is cancelled while its reefer service is requested: the service is cancelled with it, at no charge.
